data.name: Jesse
data.gender_notes: Jesse is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yishai, probably 'gift' or a short form of a name meaning 'Yahweh exists'. Its root is Hebrew y-sh-y. Jesse, father of King David (1 Samuel 16). Jesse is a Hebrew name meaning “Gift; (also) Yahweh exists”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jesse expresses “Gift; (also) Yahweh exists”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Yishai, probably 'gift' or a short form of a name meaning 'Yahweh exists'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jesse total 13, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
